notes.title: LAST UPDATE (in Early Access) !!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26072916/204e0f80bcd281ed7c75373562013eef3b2a3c87.png[/img]
Finally the last feature update is here, giving you access to all game worlds, levels and features! 
You now also have the last chance to get the game with the EARLY ACCESS DISCOUNT before it will be full released with the normal price (about 15 $).

Of course you can also still participate in the bug contest or spelling error contest to win a free Steam game of your choise - but hurry up, time is running! For all who wants to get a boost for their points in the spelling error contest: Complete the game and then you can also report errors in the programming tutorial!

Last but not least I want to thank you all for your great support, your feedback, ideas or feature request! Some of them I could include into the game, some not. Without you the game would not be the same - YOU'RE THE BEST!!!

notes.title: Update EA1.113 is online!
notes.content:
With this update some things are changing regrading the controls:
Many people didn't liked that shooting the laser was on "SPACE". Now it is on "SHIFT" or "CTRL". Jumping is now "SPACE".

If you now want to open the help texts of the codes, you will have to use F1-F9. If you're using a laptop you maybe have to use the "FN" key too.

To exit the hacking menu you now have to use "ESC".

Quadrant 9 is now a liitle bit easier.

The loading time when entering a new quadrant has been decreased.

BUG FIX: The boss in q10 sometimes didn't moved up again.
BUG FIX: Sometimes Debugger 3.16 was pushed through a closed door in q10.
BUG FIX: There was the possibility in q10 to move the open-source block outside the level meaning that you could not defeat the boss.
BUG FIX: Sometimes the GameOver screen was not showing up when falling into poisen water. 

The space world still need some time, stay tuned for more infos soon!

notes.title: Update EA1.111
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26072916/8881f457229f217ea814fe202656cc422950a8b4.png[/img]
A new update is online!

This update...

... is adding the second part of the boss fight with the evil Dr. Q - I think this is the hardest level in the game - don't enter it unprepared! ;)

...gives you a new function: undo(); 
If you ever moved a block to a wrong place, just call this function to move it back.

... is fixing the zoom level of the camera. If you now switch to another level or load a game, the zoom level will be the same.

... is deleting some real bugs:
-> sometimes the Debugger was damaged even if he was protected
-> problems with hitting bugs with low fps
-> quadrant 29 was not marked as bug free even it was 
-> wrong hit radius of the explosing bugs in the desert 

I hope you enjoy it... For next month i'm planning to complete and release the next game world which is waiting for your help. This game is called "Star Cheetah" :)

Happy gaming everyone!

If you find new bugs or wrong translations in the game: Please post them, you can still win a free Steam game of your choise - see the forum discussions for more details about this contest.
